reviews.question: Can Vega establish a difference in IQ, or only recall?
reviews.answer:
No. The Vega excerpt says intelligence was not measured, so it cannot establish an IQ difference. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-7b4031d9369a2b27ba3901ad/1)

It reports recall: spaced retrieval participants recalled 72%, compared with 51% for rereading. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-7b4031d9369a2b27ba3901ad/1)
